summary: Completed testing of SmartExpense app iteration 2 with wallet functionality and Indian Rupee currency. Backend APIs fully functional with 21/21 tests passing. Frontend core features working but modal interaction issues identified.

ui_bugs.issue: Modal backdrop intercepting clicks preventing form interactions

integration_issues.issue: Modal overlay prevents category and payment method selection

passed_tests: Password show/hide toggle on login form
Password show/hide toggle on registration form
User registration with ₹10,000 starting wallet balance
Wallet balance display with ₹ symbol and Indian formatting
Add Money feature - successfully added ₹500 to wallet
Monthly Income and Monthly Spending cards show ₹ formatting
Wallet card shows Add Money and History buttons
Payment methods dropdown includes: Cash, UPI, Debit Card, Credit Card
All backend APIs working (21/21 tests passed)
Analytics overview showing wallet balance in ₹
Currency formatting throughout app uses ₹ symbol
User authentication and JWT token handling
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix modal overlay z-index issues preventing form interactions. The backdrop overlay is intercepting clicks on dropdown selectors and form elements. Consider adjusting modal backdrop behavior or z-index values to allow proper form interactions.

success_percentage.frontend: 75% (core wallet features working, modal interaction issues)
